name: od-active-ui-development
title: Active UI development
description: Improve an existing website through browser annotations, user feedback, and focused UX research. Patch the original source and verify the result in the running app.

useCase.query: Improve the existing website using the user's browser annotations, feedback, and research goals. Before patching, establish the active writable source root from the opened or imported source project; linked directories remain read-only references. Inspect the running UI and its original source, make the smallest useful changes in the current stack, and verify the affected interactions in the browser.
